name: @sos-2/task-runtime
description: SOS 2.0 Task Runtime (Work Order P12): durable per-task state + resumable execution over the merged P5 execution fabric and P6 task graph. Durable state covers the full section 6 field list of spec/productization-execution-architecture.md as typed records with CONTENT-ADDRESSED checkpoints: a checkpoint records the exact graph node, workspace/repository revision, authority context, artifacts and unresolved uncertainty at capture time; its integrity is verified (content-addressed) before any resume — a corrupted or tampered checkpoint fails closed as a typed CHECKPOINT_INVALID denial, never silently re-derived. A task resumed from a verified checkpoint continues the SAME work graph (P6) from that node — never restarts silently, never skips verification, never fabricates progress. Cancellation is first-class and durable: a cancelled task stays cancelled across body replacement (pinned) and emits the P9 action evidence chain. The task timeline is a durable, replayable DERIVED VIEW per task (lease grants, heartbeats, checkpoints, recoveries, cancellations, completions) — never a second source of truth. Body-loss recovery executes typed RecoveryPlans (@sos-2/autonomy-runtime) through the fabric's body replacement, preserving task/artifact identity. Determinism: no Date.now/Math.random/fetch/process.env/ambient timers in this package's src — the clock, stores and sinks are injected.
